modulation of host small GTPase mediated signal transduction by symbiont
perturbation of host small GTPase mediated signal transduction
regulation by symbiont of host small GTPase mediated signal transduction

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts a small GTPase-mediated signal transduction pathway in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host small GTPase-mediated signal transduction
